command: import os,pymysql; c=pymysql.connect(host=os.environ['DB_HOST'],port=int(os.environ['DB_PORT']),user=os.environ['DB_USERNAME'],password=os.environ['DB_PASSWORD'],database=os.environ['DB_DATABASE']); q=c.cursor(); q.execute('SELECT DATABASE(),COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=DATABASE()'); print(q.fetchall()); c.close()
